messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: egress instability detected in ireland-1 (zone b). multiple customer sessions seeing 502/timeout for external egress to cloud-provider X. severity: P2 - potential customer impact. more details in the runbook: link_to_runbook
sara (oncall): ack. oncall taking lead. starting capture on affected hosts in ireland-1. pinging net/infra. please avoid mass restarts until we confirm routing state.
kevin (sre): looking. seeing increased TCP retransmits from egress gateway pool egw-ire-b. pulling conntrack and kernel counters now.
marta (network): noticed BGP withdraws for one upstream peer in the eu edge fabric around 13:12 UTC. routing flaps -> some paths are cycling. not full peer down but intermittent reachability. working with provider.
raj (support): triage notes: two customers reported degraded generation latency and failed webhooks. collecting customer IDs and logs, will prepare targeted notifications after we confirm scope.
kevin (sre): quick grep of gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T13:11:54Z egw-ire-b kernel: TCP: Retransmission timeout on socket 0x7f2d
2026-03-15T13:12:03Z egw-ire-b conntrack: NEW src=10.4.2.5 dst=52.16.34.12 sport=52012 dport=443
```
kevin (sre): hypothesis: partial egress blackholing due to upstream peer intermittent blackhole; traffic failing over sometimes but KV cache traffic exacerbates hit amplification.
sara (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic from ireland-1 -> upstream-peer-A to alternate upstream-peer-B using BGP community (marta to apply); 2) temporarily increase cache TTL for critical prefix to reduce new egress sessions; 3) enable regional fallback to west-eu1 for affected model serving routes for customers with failover opt-in. executing now.
marta (network): applying community to prefer upstream-peer-B for egw-ire-b, pushing policy in 30s. will monitor BGP state.
statuspage-bot: Draft status page update created (private):
"We are investigating intermittent external egress issues affecting ireland-1 zone B which may cause increased latencies and failed requests for some customers. Our network team is actively working with the transit provider and we are routing traffic to alternate peers to mitigate. A follow-up update will be posted within 15 minutes."
lia (product): please include suggested customer-facing phrasing we can send via email for affected tenants. keep it short and actionable.
raj (support): proposed customer note (short):
"We are investigating an intermittent networking issue affecting inference requests from the ireland-1 region. Some requests may return errors or experience higher latency. We are failing traffic to an alternate route and expect steady recovery shortly. We will update you as the situation changes. — Redwood Inference Support"
sara (oncall): nice. raj, please prepare targeted sends for the two impacted accounts once I confirm they are on failover opt-in. include context that we can shift them to west-eu1 and coordinate a cutover if they want immediate mitigation.
kevin (sre): after policy change, I see reduced retransmits on egw-ire-b and backend success rates improving. tailing logs for 5 more mins.
marta (network): provider acknowledged packet loss on one of their POPs; they claim to be mitigating. our BGP pref change shows stable adjacencies now.
sara (oncall): updating incident timeline: 13:11 UTC - alert fired. 13:14 - BGP pref applied. 13:18 - initial success metrics trending up. 13:22 - statuspage draft posted. current: services recovering, but still monitoring for residual errors. targeting customer update at 13:30 UTC.
statuspage-bot: Public status update posted: "Partial egress instability in ireland-1 (zone B) causing intermittent errors. We have applied routing changes to divert traffic to alternate upstream peers and are monitoring recovery. No action required from customers at this time."
lia (product): suggestion: add a short FAQ line about failover behavior and how customers can opt into cross-region fallback for critical workloads.
raj (support): sending customer DM drafts to assigned account owners now. will BCC ops for visibility. tagging: @sara (oncall) for final go-ahead.
sara (oncall): go ahead for the two impacted customers. if they accept, coordinate with kevin to perform regional fallback and note any model re-load impacts.
kevin (sre): planned command to trigger regional fallback for a tenant:
```
redwoodctl route set --tenant <TENANT_ID> --region west-eu1 --force --note "incident 2300001234 fallback"
```
marta (network): removing temporary community in 20m if provider confirms stable; will keep alarms up.
sara (oncall): handing off to night oncall @kevin at 13:45 UTC. my checklist: - confirm provider stable - confirm two customers notified - leave statuspage in monitoring mode - escalate to eng-network if errors persist beyond 45m
kevin (sre): ack takeover. will monitor next 2 hours and escalate if error rate > 2% of baseline for region.
incident-bot: NOTE: paging status changed to acknowledged by sara (oncall) at 13:13 UTC. oncall handoff scheduled at 13:45 UTC to kevin (sre).
raj (support): final note: customers have asked for post-incident summary. I will draft a short RCA blurb once we have full logs from provider and devicestatus from egw hosts.
sara (oncall): closing message from me: keep an eye on any new pages. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
kevin (sre): will post a short post-incident summary in this thread after monitoring window closes.
